A FEW WAYS IN

Follow your curiosity.

Drag to draw with mouse, pen or one finger. The sculpture keeps rotating while you draw. Rotation speed controls the turn; Pen depth layers strokes through space. Arrows orbit; scroll / pinch / + / − zooms. P freezes rotation while you keep drawing. U, Space or Command/Control-Z undo. Clear drawing is undoable. R resets the view. Color changes the next stroke; Save frame exports PNG. Reduced motion starts paused.

The mathematics

The pen works on a plane facing the camera. Every new point is transformed back into the sculpture’s coordinates using the inverse of the current rotation, so it stays in space as the sculpture turns. Holding the pen still while the scene rotates can draw a curved thread. Rotation speed changes smoothly; Pen depth moves the drawing plane. The drawing starts empty. Mouse, touch and pen all draw; a two-finger pinch zooms. Arrows orbit manually. P pauses automatic rotation while drawing stays available. Space, U or Command/Control-Z undo a stroke; Undo can also restore the most recent clear. R resets the view without changing the drawing. Colors apply to new strokes. Save frame exports the current view as PNG.
